excerpt: Your model. Your data. Trained for your job. The opening slide: what Sigvard does in one line. Address in the product: tuning.sigvard.ai/. Full page: 900 px tall. Sigvard is a platform for fine-tuning and post-training open LLMs on rented GPUs: bring a dataset, pick a base model, and Sigvard checks the data, plans the run on a card it rents for you, trains, scores every checkpoint by every function of the run and hands back the checkpoint you pick, or the last one. This tour shows every portal of the live product, page by page, in the order a team meets it. Full-length screenshots are available in light and dark themes. 7 portals, 71 pages. A plain-text version is at the product itself is at tuning.sigvard.ai and its documentation at docs.sigvard.ai. The public site: one idea per slide, from your data to a trained model and its price. Datasets come in from Hugging Face or your own files. Address in the product: tuning.sigvard.ai/data-bring. Full page: 900 px tall. Lengths, shapes and columns, shown before any GPU is rented. Address in the product: tuning.sigvard.ai/data-inside. Full page: 900 px tall. Rows are read for quality, personal data and duplicates. Address in the product: tuning.sigvard.ai/data-review. Full page: 900 px tall. Findings turn into fixes on the dataset itself. Address in the product: tuning.sigvard.ai/data-act. Full page: 900 px tall. Any open model from Hugging Face is a starting point. Address in the product: tuning.sigvard.ai/train-model. Full page: 900 px tall. A run is set by its goal and measured against it. Address in the product: tuning.sigvard.ai/train-goal. Full page: 900 px tall. Guided starts pick the settings for the goal you choose. Address in the product: tuning.sigvard.ai/train-shape. Full page: 900 px tall. Loss, evaluations and the machine, streamed while it trains. Address in the product: tuning.sigvard.ai/train-watch. Full page: 900 px tall.
